brand.name: D.O.X Capital
brand.tone: Institutional gravitas, authoritative, premium, transparent, Fortune 500 confidence

typography.strategy: Swiss Brutalist meets Old Money Tech. Radical weight contrast. Tight tracking for headings, sterile precision for body.

colors.strategy: Monochromatic silver/white on deep obsidian. 95% of the UI is monochrome. Accent used sparingly for success metrics ($1M+). Zero use of teal or purple.

layout_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy, 2-3x more spacing. Grid Borders (The Technical Look) for data and dashboards.
layout_spacing.grid_marketing: Bento Grid Mode A (Tetris Grid) - asymmetrical, gaps of 8-12
layout_spacing.grid_dashboard: Bento Grid Mode B (Control Room) - dense, gaps of 4-6
layout_spacing.corners: rounded-none or rounded-sm (max 8px) for sharp, institutional edge
layout_spacing.alignment: Optical alignment. Left-align dense content. Grid items must be direct children.

surfaces.header: Crystal Glass: bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-xl and 1px border-white/10.
surfaces.cards_marketing: Tracing Beam (Linear look) or crisp 1px borders with subtle ambient shadows.
surfaces.dashboard_widgets: Flat solid background matching parent, 1px border-white/10, high contrast text.

motion_3d.hero: React Three Fiber / Spline for Gemini-level abstract glass/metallic geometry. If unavailable, use parallax with the provided abstract glass images.
motion_3d.scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling for premium momentum.
motion_3d.interactions: Framer motion for subtle hover lifts and tracing beam borders on feature cards.
motion_3d.transitions: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

components.marketing: Raw HTML/Tailwind for asymmetrical layouts. Avoid default Shadcn cards for marketing.
components.dashboard: Shadcn UI heavily customized. Flat solid surfaces, 1px subtle borders. No heavy shadows. Dense spacing.
components.forms: Shadcn forms, inputs, selects. Minimalist styling with sharp 1px border on focus.
components.icons: lucide-react with 1px stroke width for a sharp, technical Apple-like aesthetic.
components.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attributes (kebab-case, role-based).

features: Jitsi Meet link generation (free video meeting)

Low angle view of a modern glass skyscraper to represent institutional confidence and scale.

media.instructions_to_main_agent: Use the exact image URLs provided. Do not use generic placeholders. The UI must feel like a Fortune 500 institutional finance firm—stark, sharp, and highly trustworthy (Apple-grade aesthetics). Prioritize pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing layouts and Shadcn (customized) for the dashboard. Ensure the routing handles the pending approval flow correctly. Use the contact email deptofx@proton.me in footers and relevant contact points.
